note: Para 63 says an unnamed Eritrean Police Force computerized data system has enabled systematic management of crime records, registration of all cars and road traffic violations, and financial and personnel management; it does not say who enters the crime records, where, or whether stations use it, so the system cannot be classed as record, statistics or identification and gives no fact. Para 58 says claims of abuse are registered at stations in the Police Diary, medium not stated. Para 56 gives police centres in 53 sub-regions and 34 additional stations for remote areas, with no statement on how they record.
